olga: Heads-up — after last night's rollout I'm seeing a big jump in SSE first-token latency for a subset of streamed toolcall requests. 99p went from ~120ms to ~480ms in prod :eyes:
samir: ugh. any pattern? model / route / tenant?
olga: only on requests that hit the KV prefetch path + toolcall framing. trunk deploy 2004010789. spike started immediately after that deploy. sample trace attached below.
olga: ```
trace: request=abc123 route=/v1/stream/toolcall first_token=480ms
  callstack: runtime::serve -> sse::flush_frames -> kv::prefetch_locked -> proto::serialize_frame -> io::write
```
mason: I profiled a few traces — there's a ~70-110ms tail inside `proto::serialize_frame` but the big pause is a synchronous lock at `kv::prefetch_locked` that holds across the frame flush. looks like we introduced prefetch sync on the hot path in PR #5678.
lee: can you confirm CI perf job? was there a regression in the perf suite around the same time?
devops-bot: Deploy 2004010789 -> promoted to prod at 2026-03-17T02:12:34Z. No automated rollback triggered.
anya: i'll run a quick git bisect on staging to verify. tagging me if you want me to run on prod traces as well. :rocket:
anya: commands i'm running:
```
git bisect start 2004010789 2004010000
# mark good known-good 2004010000, bad 2004010789
```
anya: bisect landed on commit c3f9d2 (PR #5678, "kv: prefetch on accept path") — repro locally on staging.
samir: nice find. is the prefetch doing IO or heavy CPU?
mason: prefetch issues: 1) it grabs a global read/write-prefetch mutex, 2) synchronous RPCs to the metadata service on miss, 3) then we call proto serialization while still holding the lock. combined with SSE chunk coalescing it serializes multiple toolcall frames while blocked.
olga: confirms matches prod flamegraphs — lock hold correlates to the 300-400ms spike; toolcall serialization adds another ~80ms per frame.
lee: urgent mitigation options? revert, hotfix the lock, or async prefetch?
anya: created rollback PR #5709 that reverts only the prefetch-on-accept change (keeps other unrelated fixes). rolling to canary now.
devops-bot: Rollback PR #5709 merged to canary at 2026-03-17T03:01:10Z. Canary traffic ramp 10% -> monitoring.
olga: canary stats: 99p back down to ~130ms within 20m after revert :thumbsup:
mason: confirmed — when we remove the synchronous prefetch the lock hold disappears from flamegraph and proto serialization times return to baseline.
samir: great. let's hold the full rollout until we design an async prefetch that doesn't hold the flush lock.
lee: follow-ups: 1) write unit/regression test for streaming hotpath to catch sync prefetch holds, 2) design async prefetch or per-shard locks, 3) optimize proto path to avoid serialization while any remote call is outstanding.
olga: i'm writing a small repro harness and will add a perf test to CI that simulates toolcall+kv miss patterns. putting a rollout-blocker tag on the revert until fix is in.
anya: noted. I'll pair with @mason tomorrow to sketch the async prefetch.
olga: thanks all. adding links: commit: https://git.internal/redwood/commit/c3f9d2, revert PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/5709, perf traces: https://observability/internal/trace/abc123 :bug:
samir: nice triage. leaving notes in the incident doc and closing this thread after we have a follow-up plan. :eyes:
